title: Div-Seq
scope: Habib 2016 Div-Seq: in vivo EdU pulse labeling, fluorescent selection of individual labeled nuclei, and nuclear RNA-derived cDNA library preparation as depicted by Illumina. The primary target is Div-Seq alone. Modified Smart-Seq2 is an embedded library-preparation component. Adjacent Nuc-Seq, SCRB-Seq and partial inDrop rows and the standalone N6-methyladenosine drawing are outside the assigned target. The generic Single cell/poly(A) icon introduces the assay concept and is not a separate cell-to-tissue transformation. The final depicted product is an indexed physical library; no sequencing/data-processing branch is added.

method_scopes.rationale: All eight local action blocks apply to the scoped Div-Seq route. The primary Science article explicitly combines EdU pulse labeling with sNuc-Seq, and its Fig. 3A states the label-to-fluorescence-to-FACS interface; Fig. 1A identifies modified Smart-Seq2. The Illumina row supplies the schematic library-preparation architecture. The separately depicted mRNA fragment is treated as the nuclear RNA template within the sorted-nucleus-to-cDNA block, without inventing an isolated RNA preparation. Nuc-Seq and Smart-Seq2 are contextual/embedded names here, not additional target methods. One additional poster has a misplaced SCRB-Seq description, resolved in c1_scope_caption.

corrections.diagram_observation: In the single-cell poster middle row, the Div-Seq heading is followed at left by the descriptor Single-cell RNA barcoding and sequencing (SCRB-Seq). The rest of that same row depicts EdU-labeled tissue, nuclei isolation, Click-IT tagging, FACS and the Div-Seq cDNA library route. The primary diagram and the RNA poster instead describe Nuc-Seq with EdU-mediated labeling of proliferating cells.
corrections.primary_statement: Habib 2016 defines Div-Seq as sNuc-Seq combined with EdU pulse labeling and specifies fluorescent tagging and FACS capture of EdU-labeled nuclei. The SCRB-Seq descriptor is therefore resolved as a misplaced description in the additional poster; this record implements the Div-Seq route and does not add a SCRB-Seq barcode/pooling workflow.

unknowns.question: How are the depicted Index 1/Index 2 combinations assigned to individual sorted nuclei in the Habib 2016 implementation? The inspected main-text/figure-caption source establishes individual nuclear profiling but does not provide the per-nucleus indexing/compartment map. Resolving that encoding would require a registered supplementary library-preparation/indexing passage. The schematic-level route and EdU selection do not depend on inventing that map.
